cli_tools.description: Scaffold new Prolog project with src/, tests/, bakage.toml, and .agents/

cli_tools.description: Synchronize package versions across pyproject.toml, bakage.toml, pack.pl, package.json, README.md, and CHANGELOG.md

cli_tools.description: Verify version string parity across all manifest files
